card: One evidence-record kernel: registry-driven replay-save and school census
guards: case 5 (record keys equal committed U6c record) and case 7 (u1 shim keeps U1 path) pin existing behaviour; red before only because the modules did not exist
deviations_from_card: Commit order is kernel+replay-save+shims, census+shims, then the test commit, so each commit compiles and the test commit lands green (a test-first commit would import missing modules). Added runReplaySave({wave, make, root}) so case 4's non-zero exit is tested on an injected make in a temp evidence root. replaySaveCli falls back to MAGE_EVIDENCE when --wave is absent; u3-replay shim keeps MAGE_EVIDENCE ?? 'U3'. Record keys and order unchanged; exactBytes is now derived (a===b) instead of a literal. No evidence JSON rewritten.
notes: Equivalence measured from a scratch cwd (packages junction, output outside the repo): old u3-replay (git show 290a90d) vs new u3-replay shim with MAGE_EVIDENCE=U6c on the same tree -> replay-save.json identical except command ('replay-save.ts --wave U6c'), hash 4f479c2b..., 1,300,369 bytes, passed true. Old vs new cf-report before and h1-report after -> before.json/after.json byte-identical and stdout identical. Whole-tree gate red on sibling in-flight work only, re-run once after ~1 min: npm run build fails at tsc on packages/core/src/arena/ledger.test.ts(130) (arena-kernel challenge), and vitest fails packages/core/src/arena/ledger.test.ts + contact.test.ts (697/698 pass, 83/85 files); lint --max-warnings 0 green. Shared surfaces not touched. cf1-browser.ts / u3-browser.ts still hand-parse MAGE_EVIDENCE (out of write set). Docs keep quoting the legacy commands, which still work; committed records still carry their old command strings until each wave is re-recorded.
